text:
mari: Heads-up: building a small, staggered DP pilot for Private. need intake form, acceptance gates, and a minimal legal stub for observability access.

alex_r: Two-step intake makes sense (interest -> technical). keeps noise low.

june: Agreed. Step 1 = quick opt-in (company, contact, one-line pilot goal). Step 2 = technical + compliance (network type, expected QPS, SSO/KMS, allowed log granularity).

mari: For log granularity options: none, metrics-only, redacted request traces, full traces (DPA required). also capture whether partner can host agent connectors.

alex_r: Add a support runway field (dev-days or SE hours) so eng can budget onboarding work.

june: Also require partners to upload a 20-30 prompt sample set and define primary success metric (latency SLO, accuracy threshold, or ROI signal).

tom: Legal: any partner-level request logs with PII need explicit DPA consent. I'll produce a one-page DPA summary and an NDA template; don't want full contracts before opt-in.

mari: Good. Acceptance gates per wave: infra provisioned, onboarding checklist complete, 2 successful smoke runs within latency SLO, and security scan or sign-off. Wave sizing: wave A = 3 partners, wave B = 6.

alex_r: Include a fallback/rollback clause: automatic routing to fallback model when quality or latency breaches thresholds. needs to be in intake as safety net.

june: Feedback cadence: weekly syncs during onboarding (3 weeks), then biweekly. partners agree to prompt-set based evals we can run and share results on.

mari: Success criteria proposal: 1) <=1 incident/week (stability), 2) quality pass rate on partner prompt set >= threshold, 3) measurable product signal or ROI within pilot window.

tom: I'll draft the DPA summary and add compliance flags in the intake (SOC2/ISO/other).

alex_r: I'll put together a minimal YAML config template for partners: network, model family, obs toggles, fallback routing.

mari: dp-bot: create a candidate sheet and placeholder calendar for wave A outreach when we have list.

dp-bot: created board "private-dp-staggered" and spreadsheet stub at /product/pilots/private-dp-staggered.csv. invited Mari, Alex_R, June, Tom :white_check_mark:

mari: Please each drop 3 must-have intake fields into the sheet by EOD tomorrow (short list). reconvene Fri 9:30 to finalize intake and outreach copy.

alex_r: Will add infra, obs granularity, support runway.

june: Will add prompt samples, onboarding hours, security contact.

tom: Will add DPA link, NDA status, compliance flags.

mari: thanks all — keeping thread short so we can use sheet for details.
